key.name: top-bar-style
key.description: “glass”: see-through, with no colour of its own, with the island as a black notch hanging from the top of the screen. “black”: the island blends into a black bar. (A “theme” setting from before 0.7.3 reads as glass.)

key.name: island-theme
key.description: black: Isle's own black island. glass: clear dark glass over what is behind it, blurred, with a lit rim.

key.name: glass-tint
key.description: With the Glass look: how dark the glass is, from 0 (clear, what is behind shows through) to 100 (dark frosted glass). Still blurred either way.

key.name: top-bar-opacity
key.description: How black the top bar beside the island is, in %: 0 is glass, 100 is black and the island blends into it. Unset, top-bar-style decides.

key.name: compact-top-bar
key.description: Make the top bar slimmer, so it frames the island like a thin bezel.

key.name: island-in-top-bar
key.summary: Closed island inside the top bar
key.description: Like a notch: the top bar is as tall as the closed island (plus the space below it), so it never covers windows. Alerts and the open island still hang below it for a moment.

key.name: lyrics-online
key.description: From LRCLIB, by the song's title, artist and length.

key.name: check-updates
key.summary: Say when a newer Isle is out
key.description: Isle asks GitHub for its latest release at most once a day.

key.name: update-shown
key.summary: The newest version already announced, so each is said once

key.name: prefs-page
key.summary: The Settings page to open on next, once
key.description: The island's Update button sets it to show About, where the update is.

key.name: open-on
key.description: "hover": when the pointer rests on it. "click": only when clicked.

key.name: hover-delay
key.summary: How long the pointer rests before the island opens, in milliseconds

key.name: island-monitor
key.description: "primary": the main display, in its top bar. "active": the display of the window in use; on a display without a top bar it hangs from the top edge.

key.name: notch-depth
key.description: How far the closed island hangs below the top bar, in pixels, when it is not inside the top bar.

key.name: notch-gap
key.description: With the closed island inside the top bar: the top bar is a little taller than the island, so the island stops just short of the windows below. Off, they are the same height. It shows on a see-through or grey bar.

key.name: replace-osd
key.summary: Show volume and brightness in the island

key.name: system-alerts
key.summary: Show battery, network, Bluetooth and Caps Lock alerts
key.description: Before 0.7, one switch for all four; now each has its own (alert-power, alert-network, alert-bluetooth, alert-caps-lock), and this one is only read once to carry an "off" over.

key.name: event-alerts
key.description: An alert before each event with a time, with a Join button when it has a meeting link.

key.name: event-alert-minutes
key.summary: Minutes before an event its alert shows

key.name: event-calendar
key.description: The desktop calendar (an Evolution Data Server source uid, such as an Online Accounts calendar) the Calendar page and the assistant add events to; "isle" for Isle's own calendar on this computer; empty for the first account's calendar, or Isle's own without one.

key.name: world-clocks
key.summary: World clocks on the Calendar page
key.description: A globe on the Calendar page shows the time in the cities of GNOME’s World Clocks.

key.name: hidden-pages
key.summary: Pages left out of the island
key.description: Names of the open island’s pages that have no tab: music, notifications, focus, reminders, shelf, calendar. The Apps and Usage pages have their own switches (app-usage, usage-enabled).

key.name: app-usage
key.summary: The Apps page, timing the application in front
key.description: Shows the Apps page and times the application in front, whether or not there is keyboard or pointer input, keeping 30 days on this computer. Time pauses after five idle minutes, unless a video or another program holds the session awake. Off until you turn it on; off, nothing is timed and the page has no tab.

key.name: app-usage-clear
key.description: Settings asks the island to forget the app usage; the island resets this to false when it has.

key.name: agent-alerts-claude
key.summary: Answer Claude Code from the island
key.description: When on, Isle adds a hook to Claude Code's settings so it hears when Claude needs you or is done; off removes it.

key.name: agent-alerts-codex
key.description: When on, Isle adds hooks to Codex's hooks.json so it hears when Codex needs you or is done; off removes them.

key.name: agents-announced
key.summary: AI agents already told they are connected
key.description: Isle says once, the first time, that it connected to each agent.

key.name: gnome-banners
key.summary: Leave notifications to GNOME's own banners
key.description: The island then shows no notification alerts; its Notifications page still lists them.

key.name: super-v
key.description: "isle": the island's clipboard history. "gnome": GNOME's own calendar and notification list.

key.name: track-peek
key.summary: Briefly show the new song when the track changes

key.name: privacy-indicators
key.summary: Show when the camera, microphone or screen sharing is in use

key.name: call-activity
key.description: While an app uses the microphone for a call (WhatsApp, Telegram, Meet in a browser…), the island shows it, with mute and a way back to the call.

key.name: call-preview
key.description: The open island shows the call's window as it is on screen, so you see yourself and whoever you call. The shell draws it from the window; nothing is recorded, and it is hidden while you share your screen.

key.name: focus-dnd
key.summary: Turn on Do Not Disturb during focus sessions

key.name: focus-dnd-owned
key.summary: Internal: Do Not Disturb was turned on by a focus session
key.description: Kept across restarts and the lock screen so Isle can turn it off again afterwards.

key.name: focus-dnd-declined
key.summary: Internal: the focus session Do Not Disturb was turned off in
key.description: When that session started (milliseconds), so Do Not Disturb stays off until it ends, past the lock screen too; -1 for none.

key.name: clipboard-history
key.summary: Keep a history of what you copy
key.description: Text, links, images and files, stored only on this computer.

key.name: clipboard-layout
key.description: "horizontal": cards side by side in a row. "vertical": cards stacked from top to bottom.

key.name: clipboard-width
key.description: Width of the island when the clipboard is open, in pixels.

key.name: clipboard-height
key.description: Height of the clipboard page, in pixels.

key.name: clipboard-paste-keyboard
key.summary: Paste when chosen with the keyboard
key.description: Pressing Enter on a clipboard item pastes it into the window in front; when off, it only copies the item.

key.name: clipboard-paste-mouse
key.description: Clicking a clipboard item pastes it into the window in front; when off, it only copies the item.

key.name: clipboard-ignored-apps
key.summary: Apps whose copies are never kept
key.description: Desktop app ids, e.g. password managers.

key.name: voice-assistant
key.description: Listen for requests on the shortcut and the mic button, and answer them with the AI chosen: Claude Code, Codex, Grok or Antigravity (agy).

key.name: voice-shortcut
key.description: Opens the voice assistant and listens. Pressed while listening, it finishes; after an answer, it listens again.

key.name: voice-provider
key.description: “agy” (Antigravity), “claude” (Claude Code), “codex” (Codex) or “grok” (Grok), each with its own sign-in; “auto” for the first installed and signed in.

key.name: voice-claude-model
key.description: haiku, sonnet or opus; empty for Claude Code's default.

key.name: voice-codex-model
key.description: A model id from Codex; empty for the one Codex itself uses.

key.name: voice-grok-model
key.description: A model id from Grok; empty for the one Grok itself uses.

key.name: voice-agy-model
key.description: A model id from “agy models”; empty for agy's default.

key.name: voice-speech-model
key.description: A whisper.cpp model: tiny, base, small or medium. Bigger is more accurate and slower; isle-setup-voice downloads it.

key.name: voice-language
key.description: A language code such as “id” or “en”, several (“id,en”) to tell them apart, or empty to detect any.

key.name: bot-color
key.description: One of Isle's colours (cloud, ink, peach, coral, amber, mint, teal, sky, lavender, rose, graphite) or a colour as #rrggbb.

key.name: bot-glow
key.summary: The colours the island glows with while the assistant is open
key.description: "match" follows the assistant's colour, "classic" is violet, blue and cyan, or a colour as #rrggbb to glow around.

key.name: voice-keep-chat
key.summary: How long the assistant keeps a conversation
key.description: Until midnight (never more than a day), or after 30 minutes or 2 hours without a word: then it starts a new one and deletes the old, here and in the AI's own history.

key.name: voice-use-selection
key.summary: Send the selected text to the voice assistant
key.description: So it can work on it ("make this shorter"). Never from terminals or apps kept out of the clipboard history.

key.name: voice-read-notifications
key.summary: Let the voice assistant read notifications
key.description: Send the last few notifications with each request, so the AI (Claude Code, Codex, Grok or Antigravity) can read them out or summarise them.

key.name: usage-enabled
key.description: A Usage page and warnings for Claude (signed in with Claude Code), ChatGPT (as Codex last saw it) and Grok, when found.

key.name: usage-warn
key.summary: Warn at this share of a limit (%)

key.name: usage-critical
key.summary: Warn again at this share of a limit (%)

key.name: chimes
key.summary: Play a sound when a focus session or break ends
